intro: The Ultra combines a rotating globe with an AI camera, so its problems split two ways: the ones any self-cleaning box can have, and the ones that come from relying on a lens. CATLINK makes one placement warning that rules out a lot of grief before you start.

facts.text: Joins both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz networks, so the most common pairing problem in this category does not apply.
Rated for cats between 3.5 and 22 lb.
CATLINK warns against standing it on carpet, which interferes with the sensors.
The 13 L waste bin is rated for around 20 days with one cat.

symptoms.title: Cycles misbehave or will not start on carpet
symptoms.summary: The globe hesitates, stops early or refuses to start, and the unit sits on carpet or a rug.
causes: CATLINK states that carpet interferes with the Ultra's sensors.

fixes.step: Move it to a hard floor
fixes.detail: Relocate the unit onto tile, wood or vinyl. Put any litter mat in front of it rather than underneath.

symptoms.escalate: If it still misbehaves on a hard floor, work through the common "will not cycle" steps, then contact CATLINK.

symptoms.title: The camera logs visits to the wrong cat
symptoms.summary: Health reports attribute visits to the wrong cat, or to nobody.
causes: Dim lighting makes coats and faces hard to tell apart.
The lens has picked up a film of litter dust.
Each cat profile has too few reference images, or the cats look alike.

fixes.detail: A small plug-in night light beside the unit gives the camera something to work with after dark.
Clean the camera window with a dry microfibre cloth; dust accumulates quickly beside a litter box.
Add more reference images of each cat in the CATLINK app, ideally from above, which is how the camera sees them.

symptoms.escalate: If identification is still wrong in good light with a clean lens, report it to CATLINK — that is a software issue on their side.

symptoms.title: A kitten does not register
symptoms.summary: Visits by a young or very small cat are not logged, or do not trigger a cycle.
causes: CATLINK rates the Ultra for cats from 3.5 lb. Lighter cats fall outside that range.

fixes.detail: Use a conventional tray until the kitten is comfortably over 3.5 lb, and introduce the Ultra after that.

symptoms.escalate: If a cat well over 3.5 lb is not registering, contact CATLINK.
